name: Minimum Security Requirements for Federal Information and Information Systems
issuing_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
notes: Specifies minimum security requirements for federal information systems across 17 security-related areas. Mandates use of NIST SP 800-53 controls.

derives_from.note: FISMA directs NIST to develop mandatory security standards.
Authorizes NIST to promulgate compulsory federal information security standards.

references.note: Requires FIPS 199 categorization before selecting security controls.
